Measured Exterior L10 (dBA)
The ambient noise level follows the usage of the word "ambient" throughout the environmental sciences (except acoustics). That is, the ambient noise level is that level which exists at any instant, regardless of source.
Other than the existing traffic on Lincoln Highway, there is one (1) other significant noise source. The Illinois Central Gulf Railroad tracks cross Lincoln Highway in the vicinity of the cross street known as Olympian Way.
